problems_encountered.problem: dnf install curl-devel 失败，openEuler 22.03 无此包名
problems_encountered.solution: spec 中 curl-devel 在 openEuler 映射为 libcurl-devel（已随依赖安装 7.79.1-53），提供 /usr/include/curl/curl.h
problems_encountered.source: rpm/oeAware.spec BuildRequires + openEuler 包名差异

problems_encountered.problem: build.sh 构建 smc_acc.ko 内核模块需 kernel-devel 匹配运行内核(5.10.0-216.0.0.115.oe2203sp4)，若用 24.03 默认镜像则 kernel-devel 为 6.6.x 不匹配
problems_encountered.solution: 改用 openEuler 22.03-lts-sp4 镜像(匹配宿主内核)，安装 kernel-devel-5.10.0-216.0.0.115.oe2203sp4，KDIR 软链正常

problems_encountered.problem: analysis_report_test 与 test_sdk 运行时报 liboeaware-sdk.so 找不到
problems_encountered.solution: export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/workspace/build/output/sdk 指向构建产物 sdk 目录后正常运行
problems_encountered.source: tests/CMakeLists.txt 链接 liboeaware-sdk.so 但未安装到系统库路径

problems_encountered.problem: pmu_count_test 构建成功但未出现在 build/output/tests/ 目录
problems_encountered.solution: tests/CMakeLists.txt 对其余 8 个测试设置了 RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY 但遗漏 pmu_count_test，故其输出到默认 build/tests/，从该路径执行

problems_encountered.problem: tests/ST/xcall/main.cpp 编译报 fatal error: oeaware/oe_client.h: No such file or directory
problems_encountered.solution: SDK_INC_PATH=src/sdk 但 main.cpp 包含 oeaware/oe_client.h，而头文件实际在 src/sdk/oe_client.h(无 oeaware/ 子目录)；属仓库 include 路径配置 bug，未改源码，记录为文档缺陷，其余单测正常执行

problems_encountered.problem: UtilsTest.ServiceControlTest 失败：systemctl 报 'System has not been booted with systemd as init system (PID 1). Can't operate.'
problems_encountered.solution: 容器以 sleep infinity 启动无 systemd，该测试依赖 systemctl 控制 service 属环境限制非代码缺陷；其余 33 个用例全部通过
